PRAGMA table_info(measurements);
SELECT session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, notes FROM measurements LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements;

SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog, AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_react, 
       MIN(cognitive_score) as min_cog, MAX(cognitive_score) as max_cog,
       MIN(reaction_ms) as min_react, MAX(reaction_ms) as max_react
FROM measurements;

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        -- Calculate cognitive_score percentiles using cumulative sum
        (SELECT AVG(cog) FROM (SELECT cognitive_score AS cog, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) AS rn 
                               FROM measurements m1 
                               WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.25) AS INTEGER) FROM measurements))) 
        AS q1_cog,
        -- 25th percentile
        (SELECT AVG(cog) FROM (SELECT cognitive_score AS cog, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) AS rn 
                               FROM measurements m1 
                               WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.50) AS INTEGER) FROM measurements))) AS q3_cog,
        -- 50th percentile
        (SELECT AVG(cog) FROM (SELECT cognitive_score AS cog, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) AS rn 
                               FROM measurements m1 
                               WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.75) AS INTEGER) FROM measurements))) AS q4_cog,
        -- 75th percentile
        (SELECT AVG(cog) FROM (SELECT cognitive_score AS cog, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) AS rn 
                               FROM measurements m1 
                               WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.25) AS INTEGER) FROM measurements))) AS q1_react,
        -- 25th percentile for reaction
        (SELECT AVG(re) FROM (SELECT reaction_ms AS re, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reaction_ms) AS rn 
                               FROM measurements m1 
                               WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.50) AS INTEGER) FROM measurements))) AS q3_react,
        -- 50th percentile for reaction
        (SELECT AVG(re) FROM (SELECT reaction_ms AS re, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reaction_ms) AS rn 
                               FROM measurements m1 
                               WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.75) AS INTEGER) FROM measurements))) AS q4_react
        -- 75th percentile for reaction
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT * FROM measurements;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
WITH ordered_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cog,
        re,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cog) as cog_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY re) as re_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
    FROM measurements
),
q1_cog AS (
    -- 25th percentile rank: ceil(0.25 * n)
    SELECT cog as q1_val FROM ordered_data WHERE cog_rank = 7 LIMIT 1
),
q3_cog AS (
    -- 75th percentile rank: ceil(0.75 * n)
    SELECT cog as q3_val FROM ordered_data WHERE cog_rank = 21 LIMIT 1
),
q1_react AS (
    -- 25th percentile rank
    SELECT re as q1_val FROM ordered_data WHERE re_rank = 7 LIMIT 1
),
q3_react AS (
    -- 75th percentile rank
    SELECT re as q3_val FROM ordered_data WHERE re_rank = 21 LIMIT 1
),
IQR_bounds AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT q1_val FROM q1_cog) as q1_cog,
        (SELECT q3_val FROM q3_cog) as q3_cog,
        (SELECT (SELECT q3_val FROM q3_cog) - (SELECT q1_val FROM q1_cog)) as iqr_cog,
        (SELECT q1_val FROM q1_react) as q1_react,
        (SELECT q3_val FROM q3_react) as q3_react,
        (SELECT (SELECT q3_val FROM q3_react) - (SELECT q1_val FROM q1_react)) as iqr_react
)
SELECT m.*
FROM ordered_data od
JOIN measurements m ON m.session_id = od.rowid
JOIN IQR_bounds ib ON 1=1
WHERE 
    -- cognitive_score is not an outlier
    (od.cog >= ib.q1_cog - 1.5 * ib.iqr_cog AND od.cog <= ib.q3_cog + 1.5 * ib.iqr_cog)
    -- reaction_ms is not an outlier
    AND (od.re >= ib.q1_react - 1.5 * ib.iqr_react AND od.re <= ib.q3_react + 1.5 * ib.iqr_react);

args.query:
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
WITH percentile_calcs AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT cognitive_score FROM (SELECT cognitive_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as rn FROM measurements) WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.25) AS INTEGER) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements))) as q1_cog,
        (SELECT cognitive_score FROM (SELECT cognitive_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as rn FROM measurements) WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.75) AS INTEGER) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements))) as q3_cog,
        (SELECT reaction_ms FROM (SELECT reaction_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as rn FROM measurements) WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.25) AS INTEGER) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements))) as q1_react,
        (SELECT reaction_ms FROM (SELECT reaction_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as rn FROM measurements) WHERE rn IN (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.75) AS INTEGER) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements))) as q3_react
)
SELECT m.* FROM measurements m, percentile_calcs pc
WHERE 
    m.cognitive_score >= pc.q1_cog - 1.5 * (pc.q3_cog - pc.q1_cog)
    AND m.cognitive_score <= pc.q3_cog + 1.5 * (pc.q3_cog - pc.q1_cog)
    AND m.reaction_ms >= pc.q1_react - 1.5 * (pc.q3_react - pc.q1_react)
    AND m.reaction_ms <= pc.q3_react + 1.5 * (pc.q3_react - pc.q1_react);
PRAGMA table_info(cleaned_measurements);
SELECT * FROM cleaned_measurements ORDER BY session_id;

SELECT 
    (SELECT cognitive_score FROM (SELECT cognitive_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as rn FROM measurements) WHERE rn = 7) as q1_cog,
    (SELECT cognitive_score FROM (SELECT cognitive_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cognitive_score) as rn FROM measurements) WHERE rn = 21) as q3_cog,
    (SELECT reaction_ms FROM (SELECT reaction_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as rn FROM measurements) WHERE rn = 7) as q1_react,
    (SELECT reaction_ms FROM (SELECT reaction_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reaction_ms) as rn FROM measurements) WHERE rn = 21) as q3_react;

WITH percentile_info AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT cognitive_score FROM (SELECT cognitive_score FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6)) as p25_cog,
        (SELECT cognitive_score FROM (SELECT cognitive_score FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score LIMIT 1 OFFSET 20)) as p75_cog,
        (SELECT reaction_ms FROM (SELECT reaction_ms FROM measurements ORDER BY reaction_ms LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6)) as p25_react,
        (SELECT reaction_ms FROM (SELECT reaction_ms FROM measurements ORDER BY reaction_ms LIMIT 1 OFFSET 20)) as p75_react
),
outlier_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        avg(p25_cog) - 1.5 * (avg(p75_cog) - avg(p25_cog)) as lower_cog,
        avg(p75_cog) + 1.5 * (avg(p75_cog) - avg(p25_cog)) as upper_cog,
        avg(p25_react) - 1.5 * (avg(p75_react) - avg(p25_react)) as lower_react,
        avg(p75_react) + 1.5 * (avg(p75_react) - avg(p25_react)) as upper_react
    FROM percentile_info
)
SELECT * FROM outlier_stats;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
WITH percentiles AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT cognitive_score FROM (SELECT cognitive_score FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6)) as q1_cog,
        (SELECT cognitive_score FROM (SELECT cognitive_score FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score LIMIT 1 OFFSET 20)) as q3_cog,
        (SELECT reaction_ms FROM (SELECT reaction_ms FROM measurements ORDER BY reaction_ms LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6)) as q1_react,
        (SELECT reaction_ms FROM (SELECT reaction_ms FROM measurements ORDER BY reaction_ms LIMIT 1 OFFSET 20)) as q3_react
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT 
        q1_cog - 1.5 * (q3_cog - q1_cog) as lower_cog,
        q3_cog + 1.5 * (q3_cog - q1_cog) as upper_cog,
        q1_react - 1.5 * (q3_react - q1_react) as lower_react,
        q3_react + 1.5 * (q3_react - q1_react) as upper_react
    FROM percentiles
)
SELECT m.*
FROM measurements m, bounds b
WHERE 
    m.cognitive_score >= b.lower_cog
    AND m.cognitive_score <= b.upper_cog
    AND m.reaction_ms >= b.lower_react
    AND m.reaction_ms <= b.upper_react;

bounds AS (

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as original_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements) as original_raw,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cleaned_measurements) as cleaned_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements - COUNT(*) FROM cleaned_measurements) as outliers_removed;
